images.title: Two monsoons, two rainy seasons
images.purpose: Shows that the south west monsoon brings rain in June to September and the north east monsoon in October to December.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One horizontal strip of 12 month boxes across the centre, two coloured bands on it, and a short label pair above each band.
images.exact_structure: A row of 12 equal boxes with thin grey (#6B7280) outlines, one per month from January on the left to December on the right; the first box has Jan under it. Boxes 6 to 9 (June to September) filled teal (#0072B2), with Jun to Sep under them and south west monsoon above them, and a small teal drop above box 7 labelled Mumbai peak. Boxes 10 to 12 (October to December) filled amber (#E69F00), with Oct to Dec under them and north east monsoon above them, and a small amber drop above box 11 labelled Chennai peak. Boxes 1 to 5 left white.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Mumbai's July peak comes from the south west monsoon and Chennai's November peak from the north east monsoon.
images.description: Shows that the south west monsoon brings rain in June to September and the north east monsoon in October to December.
images.context: Mumbai peaks in July, Chennai in November, as in the concept's example.

image_decisions.why: A year strip with two coloured bands shows when each monsoon brings rain, which explains the two kinds of peaks.
